title: Performance Optimization
description: Optimize Apollo Client performance in Next.js applications with selective fetching and caching strategies.

data.text: In Next.js, different pages may need different data. Instead of fetching everything in a layout, use selective fetching in each page component. Apollo Client cache is shared across the app, so data fetched on one page is available on others.

data.title: Selective fetching in page components
data.content: Each page fetches only what it needs.

blocks.tip: Use Apollo Client cache to avoid duplicate requests. If the products page already fetched a product, the detail page will use the cached data.

data.title: Cache Sharing
data.text: Use Apollo Client cache to avoid duplicate requests. If the products page already fetched a product, the detail page will use the cached data.

data.title: Performance Optimization Key Points
points: Fetch only what each page needs.
Share cache across pages for free deduplication.
Monitor bundle size with Apollo Client.
data.takeaway: Selective fetching combined with Apollo cache sharing delivers optimal performance in Next.js apps.
